info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to call out,to cry,to cry out continually,to lament,to grieve, to shed tears

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: AhvAne sakarmakaH, anyatra akarmakaH . 'AhvAne rodane krandeH kandeH krandati kandati . vEklavye tu tayorDAtvoH krandate kandate mitoH' (Slo. 105) iti devaH . ( GawAdipAWaH DA. saM. - 772 ityatra .)
